title: Did a feedback mechanism between propositional and prescriptive knowledge create modern growth?
abstract: arXiv:2512.16587v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Joel Mokyr has argued that self-sustained modern growth originated from a feedback loop between propositional (theoretical) and prescriptive (applied) knowledge that turned positive during the eighteenth century "Industrial Enlightenment". This paper presents the first quantitative test of whether such a feedback loop existed. For this, it introduces new text-based measures for 1) the innovativeness of publications and 2) knowledge spillovers. It then applies them to ca. 300,000 English publication titles and short patent descriptions, 1600--1800. The paper finds that a feedback loop between propositional and prescriptive knowledge became positive by the mid-eighteenth century, supporting Mokyr's original hypothesis.

translated_title: 命题性知识与处方性知识之间的反馈机制是否创造了现代增长？
translated_abstract: 乔尔·莫基尔（Joel Mokyr）曾提出，自我持续的现代增长源于命题性（理论）知识与处方性（应用）知识之间的反馈循环，该循环在18世纪的“工业启蒙”时期转为正向。本文首次对这种反馈循环是否存在进行了定量检验。为此，本文引入了新的基于文本的度量方法，用于衡量1）出版物的创新性以及2）知识溢出。随后，将这些方法应用于约30万条1600至1800年间的英文出版物标题和简短专利描述。研究发现，命题性知识与处方性知识之间的反馈循环在18世纪中叶转为正向，支持了莫基尔的原始假说。
tldr: 本文首次对莫基尔“工业启蒙”假说进行定量检验，通过构建基于文本的出版物创新性与知识溢出度量指标，并分析约30万条1600—1800年的英文出版物标题和专利描述，发现命题性知识与处方性知识之间的反馈循环在18世纪中叶转为正向，从而支持了该假说。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first quantitative test of Mokyr's "Industrial Enlightenment" hypothesis by introducing text-based measures of publication innovativeness and knowledge spillovers, and applying them to ~300,000 English publication titles and patent descriptions from 1600–1800, finding that the feedback loop between propositional and prescriptive knowledge turned positive by the mid-eighteenth century.
